name: science
description: Scientific and statistical computing in JavaScript.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --banner:js='var science = globalThis.science || (globalThis.science = {});' --footer:js='globalThis.science = science;' --outfile=dist/science.js && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --banner:js='var science = globalThis.science || (globalThis.science = {});' --footer:js='globalThis.science = science;' --outfile=dist/science.min.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/core/*-test.js test/lin/*-test.js test/stats/*-test.js test/stats/distribution/*-test.js
